items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: Toronto, yes, I played with him there.

ctx.x: Toronto, yes, I played with him there. We toured Canada. The second time I toured Canada was with John Kirby. See, John Kirby would be near the end of that era, because the war was coming to a close. So it would be in '45... That's the time when "Lover Man" started coming out.
The thing is, did you go with Lester before Kirby?
